claim: Replacing kinematic wave routing with local inertia equation raised peak discharge NSE from 0.48 to 0.71 in Amazon/Ganges tests.
scope_conditions: Amazon and Ganges basins, global models
quoted_support: replacing the kinematic wave approximation of the hydrologic model with the local inertia equation of CaMa-Flood greatly enhances accuracy of peak discharge simulations as expressed by an increase in the Nash–Sutcliffe efficiency (NSE) from 0.48 to 0.71.
